Anima.notes: Good vertical scaling trait. Useful when the carry benefits from raw scaling and team-wide power.

Arbiter.notes: Flexible utility trait. Better when it supports an already strong carry shell.

Bulwark.notes: Unique defensive value. Should not be overvalued unless the holder is strong.

Commander.notes: Useful unique support value for caster or utility boards.

Dark Star.notes: Excellent secondary scaling trait for both AP and AD carry shells.

Divine Duelist.notes: Strong for melee/ad duelists, less important for pure mana casters.

Doomer.notes: Vex unique trait. Penalize if it appears randomly and Vex is not relevant.

Factory New.notes: Unique upgrade value. Do not treat as normal synergy density.

Galaxy Hunter.notes: Special availability trait. Should not be assumed unless allowed.

Gun Goddess.notes: Miss Fortune unique. Good only when the unit/role fits.

Mecha.notes: Core vertical. Strong with Aurelion Sol because it gives time to cast and uses Mecha Transformer.

Meeple.notes: Can be useful, but should not beat direct carry-support traits by itself.

N.O.V.A..notes: Good flexible tempo trait. Better if units are individually strong.

Oracle.notes: Good caster support. Especially relevant for mana carries.

Party Animal.notes: General board amplifier. Good when it comes with strong units.

Redeemer.notes: One-of utility, not usually a primary reason to choose a board.

Space Groove.notes: Flexible trait. Stronger if it fits the carry shell.

Stargazer.notes: Scaling trait. Better in boards that can support long fights.

Timebreaker.notes: Tempo/frequency trait. Useful for fast-casting or attack-speed boards.

Bastion.notes: Good defensive shell for carries that need time.

Brawler.notes: Strong generic frontline. Very good for mana carries that need time to cast.

Challenger.notes: Good for attack-speed carries, weaker for pure AP mana casters.

Conduit.notes: Premium caster/mana trait. High priority for Aurelion Sol and similar AP carries.

Eradicator.notes: Damage amp trait. Good when attached to high-damage units.

Replicator.notes: Flexible utility, depends heavily on units.

Rogue.notes: Good for physical/crit carries, less useful for mana AP carries.

Vanguard.notes: Okay frontline, but usually less carry-specific than Conduit/Brawler for AP caster boards.

Voyager.notes: Very strong flexible secondary trait, especially around AP/caster shells.
